note: Spend-ledger estimates at the list prices recorded in the harness when each run happened, in USD. They are not invoices. A request that failed is charged at its full reservation unless the provider rejected it with a 4xx, so failed rows can overstate cost. Prices change: check your providers before you budget.

study2_three_judge_replay.note: Ledger tokens for failed requests are the reserved bound, not billed usage. The first paid judge run for one judge hit HTTP 400 on 16 requests; those were corrected to zero cost in the ledger. DeepSeek's recorded cost is higher than the other two judges' at the recorded rates; the ledger does not break out why.

study1_conclusion_replay.labelling: The 31,663 labels were produced by model-harness grading sessions whose cost was not tracked in the spend ledger, so no labelling cost is reported.

study3_ef_sweep.note: No other paid request: index settings only.

study4_ab_dream.note: Includes one rate-limited first attempt that was re-run. One dream per peer pair per arm, two pairs, five arms.
